rules:
The first line contains two space-separated integers n, v (1 ≤ n ≤ 50; 104 ≤ v ≤ 106) — the number of sellers and the units of money the Valera has.

Then n lines follow. The i-th line first contains integer ki (1 ≤ ki ≤ 50) the number of items of the i-th seller. Then go ki space-separated integers si1, si2, ..., siki (104 ≤ sij ≤ 106) — the current prices of the items of the i-th seller. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
